title: Chapter 192 Incomplete Report (I)
content:
Chapter 192 Incomplete Report (I)

After half an hour of siege, Xu Wen finally had less than 1,000 health points left.

At this moment, Xu Wen suddenly roared and repelled the surrounding soldiers.

"Roar"

Then, a trace of blood oozed out of the armor.

Wang Shuo's scalp was numb, this dry skeleton could actually ooze out bright red blood.

Suddenly, several blood arrows shot out from his skeleton's mouth.

"Blood-spitting"

Wang Shuo found the name of the skill used by the other party from the system background.

As long as the opponent attacks, the system will record the damage data.

"There is actually a hidden skill."

Wang Shuo was not too surprised. After all, this kind of thing is not the first time it has happened.

It is very likely that this monster has never used a skill before, which will be judged as a hidden skill.

The soldiers hit by the blood arrows are in great pain at this time. Those blocked by the armor only deducted hundreds of health points, while the wounds of those soldiers whose skin was directly touched by the blood arrows have begun to rot.

Wang Shuo was also caught off guard and was hit by a blood arrow. This change made him very anxious.

"Quick, kill Xu Wen first."

Xu Wen, who had released his ultimate move, was indeed at the end of his strength. Everyone worked together and killed him in a short while.

Before he died, Xu Wen used up his last breath and said, "Quick, submit the report to Lord Dragon King!"

Wang Shuo was a little puzzled!

At this time, another scene animation appeared.

The whole city was ablaze, and a soldier handed the blood-stained report in his hand to a guard soldier, and then fell to the ground!

The guard handed the report to a civil servant, and the civil servant handed the report to Xu Wen.

After reading it, Xu Wen's face changed drastically!

...

[You led your subordinates to kill the Undead Book Officer (Xu Wen) ID: Dragon DW6521478, Silver Boss]

[Your level has been raised to level 27. ]

[You have commanded a battle brilliantly, command value +2]

[Your "Dragon Spear Art" level is upgraded to level 4]

[Your subordinates...level upgraded...]

After the previous accumulation and this difficult battle, everyone's level has been upgraded again.

Wang Shuo's arm was also corroded and painful at this time.

He quickly took out the life potion and took it, but found that it had no effect.

As a last resort, Wang Shuo dropped a drop of water of life into the life potion, drank a small sip, and the rotten flesh and blood were magically regenerated.

It really deserves to be the water of life. As long as there is a breath, it can be saved.

He quickly asked all the injured soldiers to take it.

This time when entering the underground palace, Wang Shuo only had 3 drops of water of life on him, so he had to use it sparingly.

After the soldiers' injuries recovered, Wang Shuo walked over and picked up the items dropped by Xu Wen.

[Energy Crystal +200, Soul Crystal +10, "Government Affairs" Skill Book +1, "Blood-spattering" Skill Book +1]

Two skill books dropped at once, which made Wang Shuo very happy.

[Government Affairs: Passive skill, handling territory affairs efficiency increased by 30%, energy increased by 100 points. ]

Wang Shuo felt that after learning this skill, as long as he was not a fool, he could handle the trivial matters of a village.

Wang Shuo did not want to learn this skill, but planned to give it to the "civil servants" of the territory.

As for the skill of "Blood-spattering", it would be more appropriate to give it to military advisor Zou Yuanjie.

After putting away the two skill books, the booklet on the desk caught his attention.

Wang Shuo walked over and opened the booklet. Before he could read the text on the booklet.

The system prompt sounded.

[Side quest: Investigate the truth of the destruction of Black Dragon City. According to the completion, obtain the military research results of Black Dragon City. ]

Wang Shuo received this task and his heart was shocked. After seeing the reward, Wang Shuo attached great importance to it.

Military research results?

Any technology from Black Dragon City is enough to raise the military industry level of Wana Village by several levels.

[Obtained the incomplete report (I), and the side quest completion progress was 5%. ]

Wang Shuo picked up the report, which had a paragraph of text written on it.
